save_patch.notes: Writes the currently active patch state to slot PATCH (2-digit hex) under NAME (10-byte ASCII, zero-padded/truncated, 20 hex chars). Reverse-engineered from a live BLE HCI snoop capture of Valeton Suite's Save action, not from official docs.

change_effect.notes: BLOCK is block index (0-9), EFFECT_ID is hex effect code

change_parameter.notes: VALUE_FLOAT_HEX is float32 little-endian hex bytes

blocks.name: ns
blocks.label: NAM (Neural Amp Modeler)
blocks.note: 80 NAM snaptones (IDs 0-79), names loaded dynamically from device

sysex_format.addzero_format: each byte character is preceded by '0' (e.g. 'AB' -> '0A0B')

notes: All SysEx commands need CRC8 calculated and applied in addzero format
addzero inserts a '0' before every hex character
Float parameters are sent little-endian (4 bytes)
Each block can be toggled independently
Full sync requires multiple steps, waiting for corresponding notifications
